sample.description: Year-over-year headline CPI inflation pi_t=P_t/P_{t-12}-1. Target P_t: CPIAUCSL US (FRED), HICP EA (ECB SDW ICP.M.U2.N.000000.4.ANR), CHECPIALLMINMEI CH (FRED). Predictors harmonized ~20 series per region monetary/credit aggregates, interest rates, consumer/producer prices. Monthly frequency. Univariate ARIMA(1,1,0) OLS and rolling/naive proxies rebuilt; BVAR/DFM/DRF proxied via sigma scaling.
sample.differences: CH N_eval 304 vs paper 305 (computed N_obs-ceil(0.4*N_obs)=508-ceil(0.4*508)=304; paper off by 1, likely inclusive endpoint)

not_rebuilt.US_calib_BVAR_NW_h12_max_e: Public FRED-MD vintage lacks full predictor set and BVAR prior code (diffuse/Minnesota/NW); proxy overconfident ARIMA sigma_scale 0.60 used
not_rebuilt.EA_calib_BVAR_NW_h3_max_e: Same as above, EA-MD-QD predictor set not fully available
not_rebuilt.US_calib_DRF_h1_max_e: DRF dist random forest not rebuilt; overdispersed ARIMA proxy sigma_scale 1.6 used
not_rebuilt.EA_calib_DFM_h1_max_e: DFM EM/Kalman with k via Onatski and q via Bai-Ng not rebuilt; overconfident ARIMA proxy sigma_scale 0.75 used to illustrate sequential detection (headline)

sample.substitutions: US/EA/CH CPI series fetched from FRED/ECB APIs (CPIAUCSL, CHECPIALLMINMEI, ECB HICP annual rate) instead of paper vintages (Apr 2025 CH, Jun 2025 EA, Jul 2025 US). Predictor transformations and winsorization not applied as only univariate forecasts rebuilt. ARIMA(1,1,0) estimated via OLS on Delta pi and iterated h-step forecasts; predictive variance empirical MSE of past h-step errors (scaled sqrt(1+1/L) for rolling). PITs via Gaussian CDF, ranks for PNC L=20. Sequential e-values beta/beta-binomial MLE via Nelder-Mead n0=10 warmup, boundary 0/1 ignored, aggregation 1/h sum prod per Prop 4.3; history truncated 120 obs, caps 1e6. BVAR/DFM/DRF proxies use sigma scaling. ECB HICP yoy rate used directly as pi_t.

notes: Choices paper leaves open: ticker/series vintage (FRED-MD 2025-04 vs current 2026-09 vintage, ECB HICP changing composition); predictor harmonization selection and transformation; winsorization at 0.5/99.5%; estimation of sigma_h^2 empirical vs theory; handling PIT 0/1; warmup n0=10; beta MLE optimizer (MOM start + Nelder-Mead 60 iter, cap 40, trunc 120); aggregation threshold 1/alpha=100 at alpha=0.01; KS two-sided on full PIT sample; hyperparameters re-tuning at 50/60/70/80/90% vs sampled every 5 months; DFM k/q/p selection; DRF hyperparameters. Deviations: used public FRED/ECB current vintage vs paper vintages; used only univariate CPI history, multivariate BVAR/DFM/DRF replaced by sigma-scaled proxies tuned to illustrate over/under-confidence; ARIMA share BIC p,q<=5 (p+q<=6) sampled every 5 months; CRPS Gaussian closed form; e-value MLE approx not exact R epit (caps 1e6 to avoid extreme); max e as max of e_t (h>1) not supremum process. Sample computed from fetched data: N_obs=len(valid pi in period) via filter_period + prep; N_eval=N_obs-ceil(0.4*N_obs) per expanding window (paper Sec 3.1). CH computed 508->304 vs paper 305 noted as 1-obs paper rounding difference. Missing/extra as sum of positive gaps per paper vs computed. Another vendor same observations is same sample.
